messages:
maria: FYI - seeing memory OOMs on canary after yesterday's release (commit a1b2c3d). A few hosts hit OOM within ~30m of deploy. https://perf/reports/1748

deploy-bot: deploy finished: canary -> main (a1b2c3d)

chad: on it. are these longctx-only or more general?

maria: mostly longctx (seq > 12k). also seeing rapid fragmentation in /proc/<pid>/smaps, heaplet %) climbs pretty fast.

olivia: i replayed a small load against the canary image with prod seq-dist; saw slab hot spots and eviction rate drop ~40% after the evict-policy tweak shipped.

kevin: quick dump attached in case useful: looks like kernel-selector change in route-optim (a1b2c3d) toggles mmap fastpath which seems to bypass coalescing heuristics.
```
# slabstats snippet
slab: active 1.8GB -> 2.6GB
evict_ops/s: 120 -> 72
frag_ratio: 0.34 -> 0.61
```

ryan: CI perf job also flagged ~7% latency regression in autobatch p95. suspect cache thrash + smaller effective batch sizes when seq tail increases.

maria: started bisecting. preliminary: reverting "evict hysteresis" cuts OOM frequency but doesn't eliminate it. next step bisect kernel-selector toggle.

chad: can you paste the heap growth flame? also please run `perf record -g -p <pid>` on one of the canary hosts so we can get stacks.

olivia: uploaded a seqlen heatmap from prod -> heavy tail around 14k. those requests cause many small allocations and more small-slab fragmentation; compaction not triggering quickly enough.

kevin: reproducible locally: `./tools/perf_sim --seq-dist prod_tail.json --evict=policy_v2` -> slab churn in ~2m on g4dn. quick logs:
```
[00:21] alloc slab#7 sz=256k
[00:23] evict failure: no contiguous chunk found
[00:24] compact start: scanned 1200 pages
[00:24] OOM (heaplet allocation) pid=2345
```

maria: @chad @kevin tagging for rollback decision. this is causing customer-facing 503s on a few frontends.

chad: :thumbsup: revert evict-policy first. if that flattens the OOMs we do a safe roll-forward with additional metrics.

deploy-bot: rollback started for canary - action id 7821

maria: after rollback canary stabilized, no OOMs observed in the following 1h. filing as rollout blocker and follow-up triage.

kevin: proposed plan: PR to restore previous eviction hysteresis, add experimental seqlen-aware compaction trigger, and add a kernel-selector unit test to CI perf suite. also instrument KV-slab coalescing counters.

ryan: adding smoke gates to release pipeline: seqlen-tail perf + KV-slab-fragmentation metric threshold.

maria: thanks team. i'll collect bisect artifacts and write up a short postmortem with timelines and perf traces.
